subject: PDF audit contract inventory — A1 through A16

checks.name: Every page carries extractable text
checks.pass_condition: every page has at least MIN_PAGE_TEXT (20) stripped characters
checks.negative_fixture: blank page / image-only page / empty PDF
checks.false_positive_risk: page with only whitespace or decorative glyphs counts as text
checks.false_negative_risk: a page whose only content is inside an image is flagged

checks.name: All fonts are embedded
checks.pass_condition: every font resource has a FontDescriptor with FontFile/FontFile2/FontFile3
checks.negative_fixture: PDF using a standard-14 font without descriptor
checks.false_positive_risk: standard-14 fonts are present but ReportLab embeds all fonts
checks.false_negative_risk: a subset font missing the descriptor entry is not caught

checks.name: Metadata and document language
checks.pass_condition: title==meta.title, author==meta.author, subject non-empty, creation date present, /Lang==meta.language
fail_fields: document language is X expected Y
checks.negative_fixture: PDF whose Info dict title differs from meta.yaml
checks.false_negative_risk: XMP-only metadata (no Info dict) is not inspected

checks.name: Outline entries point to their headings
checks.pass_condition: outline non-empty when expected and every entry resolves to a page whose text contains the heading
checks.negative_fixture: PDF with no outline, or outline pointing past last page
checks.false_negative_risk: destination resolves but lands on the wrong heading text

checks.name: Links are safe and complete
checks.pass_condition: external links are http/https; internal links carry a Dest or action /D
checks.negative_fixture: link with a javascript: or ftp: URI
checks.false_negative_risk: a link whose /A is missing both /S and /Dest is not flagged

checks.name: Every page is A4
checks.pass_condition: every page mediabox within A4_TOLERANCE (1pt) of PAGE_WIDTH x PAGE_HEIGHT
checks.false_negative_risk: a page whose mediabox is A4 but cropbox is not is not checked

checks.name: Body pages are filled to at least 87%
checks.pass_condition: every non-exempt page has fill >= 1 - max_blank_ratio (0.87)
checks.negative_fixture: decorative full-body background rectangle with one text line
checks.false_positive_risk: decorative background painted inside the body frame can inflate fill (mitigated P4.WP2)
checks.false_negative_risk: exempt pages hide genuine underfill; exemption legitimacy is tested separately

checks.name: File size is reasonable
checks.false_negative_risk: a moderately large but legitimate PDF is not flagged

checks.name: Internal links land on a page
checks.pass_condition: every internal link destination resolves to a page index in range
fail_fields: page N: a link points nowhere
checks.negative_fixture: link whose /D points at a freed/invalid object
checks.false_negative_risk: named-destination resolution failure is caught but a wrong-but-in-range page is not

checks.name: Figure and table numbers are continuous
checks.pass_condition: Figure N. and Table N. numbers each form 1..max with no gaps
checks.false_positive_risk: numbers appear in prose (not as captions) and are counted
checks.false_negative_risk: duplicate numbers collapse to a set, hiding a real duplicate

checks.name: Smallest text is at least 7.5 pt
checks.pass_condition: min rendered font size * transform scale >= MIN_FONT_SIZE (7.5)
checks.false_negative_risk: scaled text below 7.5pt inside a transformed XObject may be missed

checks.name: Raster images are sharp enough
checks.pass_condition: min_image_dpi >= MIN_IMAGE_DPI (140) when raster figures exist; N/A otherwise
fail_fields: lowest image resolution is N dpi
checks.false_positive_risk: N/A when there are no raster figures
checks.false_negative_risk: DPI is supplied by the builder, not measured by the audit

checks.name: Text contrast is at least 4.5:1
checks.false_positive_risk: contrast is supplied by the builder, not measured from the PDF
checks.false_negative_risk: unmeasured color pairs are not checked

checks.name: No active or embedded content
checks.false_negative_risk: an action in an annotation not yet enumerated would be missed

checks.name: Metadata does not leak local paths
checks.pass_condition: no Info value matches a local path pattern (/Users/, /home/, /tmp/, /var/, drive letters, backslashes)
checks.false_negative_risk: a path in XMP (not Info) is not inspected

checks.name: Text extracts cleanly
checks.pass_condition: no page text contains U+FFFD, (cid: or disallowed control characters
fail_fields: page N has replacement or control characters
checks.negative_fixture: text with U+FFFD or a bare control character
checks.false_negative_risk: control chars allowed by the allow-list (\n\r\t\x0c) are not flagged

exemption_policy.forced_pages: chapter-end pages under chapter_pages:true, plus chapter-start page+1 when chapter_pages:true
exemption_policy.rule: every exempt page must have a structural cause; forged/out-of-range/duplicate exemptions must not produce a false PASS (tested in test_phase2_audit_reporting.ExemptionLegitimacyTests)
